reviews.title: Not great anymore
reviews.text:
I used to really enjoy this app. Logging my dog's walks earned Biscuit points, which I could convert into vouchers, and that made it feel rewarding to use every day.

Since the recent update, points can only be exchanged for competition entries, where the chance of actually winning anything is very small. With the guaranteed rewards gone, the app is essentially just a walk tracker, and I already use a separate app for that.

The remaining perks don't add much for me either, as I already have a Tastecard that covers similar discounts.

Unfortunately, I no longer see a reason to keep using the app. I'd happily come back if the voucher rewards were reinstated.

reviews.title: Used to be amazing- don’t bother now zero benefits
reviews.text: What this app has done in the last year is a masterclass in how to remove your entire loyal users and your entire apps use case/purpose in one go! The removal of the the points for vouchers scheme - the main incentive to using the app - has effectively made this app irrelevant it just collects your dog walks now and then gives you points for a extremely rubbish tombolo barely anyone ever wins (and that’s my perception as a premium subscriber so can only imagine how much more rubbish it is for free users) Sure I track my dogs walks but that’s literally about the sum total of its use case and honestly could do that million other ways without this app. Before they changed the rewards system I used the app religiously and would promote to every dog walker I knew. You used to get free walking points to spend towards genuinely amazing selection of real money vouchers (I would regularly change up points for £10 m&s vouchers towards my shops) and it was genuinely epic!! They then brought in subscriptions at a cost THEN they abruptly removed the entire rewards system and replaced with these worthless tickets you can collect and effectively put towards “winning” a choice of 3 or 4 meagre prize vouchers that everyone it’s gambling tickets towards like a rubbish tombolo prize drawer. I’ve been doing it for months and not seen a single win NOR benefit to this app even WITH the premium subscription you pay for since it changed. It just feels like it collecting my data and I’m getting nothi

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text:
This used to be a brilliant app as you converted points into vouchers. Those vouchers don’t work - even though not expired. Now it’s just walking to earn points to enter a competition, some random discounts are on it for things you can get anyway online / and also to places where I’d have to travel at least an hour to get to. 
No longer use,

reviews.title: Deleted and no longer seeing it
reviews.text:
Sins update I have deleted it and no longer use it - no
Point to share your data when you get nothing back

reviews.title: It was good
reviews.text: We absolutely loved using biscuit when we were able to exchange for vouchers that we could actually use we don’t and haven’t been able to use anything regarding discount of things.  Also find it really frustrating when the app pauses itself and you don’t realise.  Would also love to know why we collect the stars ? can do with them as there seems to be a pointless task. We used love keeping our daily streak but now there is not much incentive to do it

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: This app used to be fantastic and now it is pointless. I don’t use the taste rewards as I don’t eat out very often and get free coffee which is better than what biscuits offer

reviews.title: Gone downhill and no longer worth using
reviews.text:
Really disappointed with the direction Biscuit has taken. The changes to the rewards have made it significantly harder to earn vouchers, taking away the main incentive to use the app. I’ve now stopped using it altogether.

What makes it worse is that we were given absolutely no advance warning. An email was sent on the very same day the changes came into effect, which feels incredibly sneaky and shows little consideration for loyal users.

The app was already incredibly buggy, regularly freezing and losing recorded walks, so these changes have only made the experience worse. It’s a real shame, as the concept was great, but making rewards harder to earn while failing to address ongoing technical issues is a sure-fire way to lose users. Unfortunately, that’s exactly what’s happened in my case.

reviews.title: Updates have made app worse
reviews.text:
Had been using this app for about 3 years and enjoyed tracking my walks and getting the point towards vouchers. The recent update where you get a Taste card instead of vouchers you can redeem was a rubbish change. I lost over 5000 biscuits which I had been planning to use towards National
trust vouchers and membership  to open up new walking spots for us to go to. 
I dislike eating at chains, which is all the card allows for and feel really disappointed with the change from what had been a perfectly functional and actually useful app to a pointless one. Have since deleted it.

reviews.title: Loved it, but is now pointless after the changes
reviews.text: Loved this app for tracking our daily dog walks and collecting points for a little treat here and there was a great incentive. Even when the vouchers become more expensive it was still worth it. Now we’re just entering our data to enter competitions that we probably won’t win, so it’s now just a data collecting excercise with no reimbursement to the user. I will be deleting after 4+ years.

reviews.title: Updates have ruined the app
reviews.text: I have used and loved Biscuit since early 2023. The rewards were amazing and I would often let my points stack up and trade them for coffee vouchers to treat myself during weekend long walks. Since the recent update, I couldn’t actually tell you what you gain from this app? You no longer earn points for vouchers and now it looks like it’s points for entries into competitions? You can pay monthly to unlock a better perk but looking into it, the perk is 25% discount on places which you probably already have access to a discount. I’m really disappointed in the change in this app and I hope there’s a company out there who will come and fill the space Biscuit left behind.

reviews.title: Gone from great app to rubbish
reviews.text: App has glitches frequently, so loses walks. Every time you do an update we lose out! Latest one we’ve lost the extra points, which we’re already deducted, we got on 3rd day. Also it was bad enough when the rewards went up to cost 1,000 biscuits per reward now it’s some odd figure over 1,500 that’s disgraceful. So this is to add on to the above...now you enter to win vouchers, quite often there is nothing that I can use them on due to where I live! You never win & going from a useful voucher choice to this is just dreadful. So sad to have now deleted my account & the app

reviews.title: Stolen biscuits and massive voucher process downgrade
reviews.text:
The app has had a huge revamp on its operational model that led me to lose my biscuits that were not converted into vouchers. I have not seen an appropriate notification of this transition and the benefit from using this app is now minimal! 
Likely going to change my insurance and stop using it as these competitions entries for a chance to win a voucher feel more a scam with the lack of transparency. Huge downgrade from the simple voucher transaction that existed before.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: This was such a great app when you were able to use it as an incentive to get vouchers at places I shop at daily (ASOS, Tesco, M&S etc), now they’ve removed all vouchers and you have to pay a membership which only gets you 25% off restaurants i never go to. The app is completely pointless now and not worth paying for the rubbish ‘rewards’

reviews.title: Pointless since the reward updates
reviews.text:
Pay monthly to collect biscuits that can now only be redeemed on the same generic discounts that are widely available online? Note most of these are for dog foods… messing with my dogs stomach to save a few quid doesn’t scream ‘care’ to me. 
Unless you drink endless amounts of cafe Nero the app now only benefits the companies using your tracked data.

reviews.title: Not anymore
reviews.text: It used to be very good app. But since huge change is just useless. You can not see even  who won.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: Used to be a great little app. Track the walks you do with your dog and then get little rewards. Didn’t even bother me when they added in a pay subscription as was still good. They then done another update where they basically removed all the benefits and now you get a taste card (if you pay for it) or can enter competitions. Full of ads now as well and glitchy whether it will record the walk or not. To be honest I find it more faff than it’s worth now. It’s a shame but obviously it’s what the developer of the app thought was the best way forward for it.

reviews.title: A good app ruined
reviews.text:
I’ve had this for a few years and was always good to earn rewards while walking the dog.  However, they then diluted the points accrual rate which made it harder and significantly longer to earn the same amount, unless you subscribed.  This was a significant error and screamed of greed after they assessed how many downloads.
It was made worse recently when the rewards disappeared and they introduced competition entries instead!  What are they thinking?  I’ve stuck with it but no more.  Having entered hundred’s of times with my “biscuits”, as expected nothing.  So in summary, this has been destroyed by greed and I feel there are better options out there so it’s going in the app bin.  Shame!

reviews.title: No reward points unless you pay money? No thanks!
reviews.text: I have used this app for years and enjoyed accruing points for money off coffee shops or supermarkets etc. Now there’s nothing unless you pay money£3.99 per month. That’s not earning a discount, that’s paying for a discount, which means you’re not getting a discount at all. Sorry to say this app is being deleted today.

reviews.title: Not what it was
reviews.text: Was a great app where you would receive actual vouchers for recording your walk with your dog . Now you just get a taste card which offers a few discounts on food midweek . The app itself is pretty poor many times I set a walk going then when I come back to it the walk has paused . Ok if you need a free taste card but other than that it’s not much use

reviews.title: Gutted it changed
reviews.text: Used to get so many points, was saving up points to get a bigger voucher and they’ve gone now. No point using it anymore. No vouchers or rewards worth it anymore. Apps hard to navigate, genuinely disappointed. I feel everyone would be happier if you changed it back to how it used to be. Will unfortunately be deleting now.

reviews.title: Poor since update
reviews.text: Unfortunately app is really glitchy since the last updates done. Constantly freezes and walks are lost as a result. Pity as I used to really like this app.

reviews.title: Deleted after years
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I deleted the app today as a long term user with the Plus account. 

The app has gone through so many changes. I get that before it was maybe too beneficial for the user and not sustainable for the brand. Their main goal was to promote walks, which was lovely. I loved tracking my walks and see how far I had taken my dogs. The app became a little harder to gain biscuits, but as a Waggle user this was still ok for me. Then, the complete app changed and it no longer became worth using for me.

A lot of technical issues, poor customer service and too many changes mean a lot of people lost trust in the app. I hope to use it again one day, but since the change I haven’t even logged 1 walk so I’ve finally deleted. 

I wish the brand all the best and hope they keep promoting positive walks and wellbeing with our dogs.

reviews.title: Used to be good , not anymore
reviews.text: Biscuit used to be a great concept and even though they opted for paid membership and basic version , you could still earn points to redeem in vouchers for a decent choice of stores , restaurants etc. Completely pointless now that there’s actually nothing to redeem anymore on the basic version , and by the looks of it , nothing worthwhile on the paid version either . Shame because I’ve used it for a few years and it was great . Pointless now .

reviews.title: Once Great Now Pointless
reviews.text:
Biscuits used to be a brilliant app. I paid for premium and regularly traded my earned biscuits for Amazon or PlayStation vouchers — a simple idea that actually worked. Then everything changed.

Now the rewards are limited to discounts at selected restaurants and coffee shops, with only one anywhere near me — 20 miles away — or I’d have to spend £80+ on a ferry just to use a 30% discount. I can now enter competitions for a chance to win a voucher, which isn’t what I signed up for.

What was once genuinely useful has become something I have no practical use for. I’ll be cancelling when my year is up because the value just isn’t there anymore.

reviews.title: Bad!
reviews.text: Since this app has been got downgraded, you now just get a few pence or coffee at a huge coffee chain or a Competition entry not like when you used to get vouchers for meals out. Have deleted this app as it’s a waste of time now. After being great when it started such a shame.

reviews.title: Used to be so much better…
reviews.text:
This app used to be brilliant, it was one of the best “reward for walking” apps in my opinion - app was easy to navigate and it made you motivated as the rewards were decent and feasible to earn.
Now with the paid element, you cannot earn rewards and the free option is pointless as you’re earning competition entries for small vouchers rewards…. Also there is no info on who actually wins these.

So this company is basically collecting your data for no reward.

Another frustrating element is that you’ll be on a walk, only to find that the walk has “paused” and all of your progress is lost.
Very disappointing - if the app reverted to how it was previously I would return, but I would avoid.

reviews.title: Used to love
reviews.text: I loved this app, as I walked everyday with my dog I earned quite a few vouchers. Now!! You earn to enter competitions absolutely useless. All my earnings have disappeared too xx not a happy bunny

reviews.title: Avoid this app
reviews.text: Awful app now. Removed the option to change points to vouchers but still kept taking my subscription.

reviews.title: Thankyou for all the rewards
reviews.text:
Came to say it’s a shame it’s going to paid service tho I can understand why. 

I can’t justify £3.99/m for earning the equivalent of a £6amazon voucher so I will spend my points and close but very much appreciate the vouchers over the past year or so!

If you don’t mind clicking in each walk, it’s a great tracker and much more reliable than it once was.

Edited to say that about a year after I posted review I had a developer response which is clearly a boilerplate exercise not addressing anything I have said. Other reviews have the same kind of patronising reply now. Stars detracted. I was happy to be tracked for reward but it has got WORSE since I used it last.

reviews.title: Updates not worth it
reviews.text: When you could use your points on vouchers it was great, now it’s entries into draws to earn vouchers for places you shop it’s really not worth it. It was so good, now it’s pointless

reviews.title: Used to recommend to everyone now cancelling
reviews.text: I thought the update last year was rough when we had to start paying for the decent rewards and more biscuits. Originally could get a voucher every 6-8 weeks. Which then changed to every 3-4 months. Now they’ve decided even if you pay you get tickets to possibly win a voucher. There’s no incentive to use. The taste card and coffee card for plus doesn’t include anywhere we go. Cancelled subscription and at this point I’m about to delete the app, no incentive to use and I’m sure they’ll be selling our data!

reviews.title: New version not as good
reviews.text: The old version was so much better where you collected biscuits in exchange for a range of different vouchers. Now you enter competitions which I have 2 entries everyday and still won nothing. You do get a taste card but I rarely use this as the restaurants are more expensive even though 2 for 1. If it went back to the old version I would highly recommended

reviews.title: Not what it was
reviews.text:
The old reward system was great with the vouchers and gave you an actual incentive to use the app on walks. Now it’s just 25% off cheap pub food that funnily enough - I wouldn’t feed to my dogs. 

I have the paid version through waggle and I used to recommend it to all dog owning friends, but I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone anymore sadly.

reviews.title: Pointless
reviews.text: And app that went from great to rubbish rather than improving. You used to be able to earn vouchers, now you earn tokens to enter competitions you will never win. It’s a pretty pointless app

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Don’t bother. It’s just a data grab app now, they’ve removed all decent & useful rewards replacing them with competition entries. Absolute joke, have cancelled my subscription.

reviews.title: Rubbish rewards now
reviews.text: Since the update the app is not worth paying for with only draws to potentially win nothing! Deleted my account.

reviews.title: Such a shame
reviews.text: Been with Biscuit around 4 years, completed over 200 quests… Used to earn biscuits for every walk and then trade them for vouchers, all changed now, still get biscuits for walking but only to enter competitions to try and win what we used to get with our biscuits, oh, and now pay £5 per dog a month for the privilege! I don’t think so, app being deleted, so disappointing…

reviews.title: No vouchers, just competition entries and discounts off coffee
reviews.text: Well, I have been using the biscuit app for around just over three years and I used to enjoy turning on the app and my Strava and going out for nice long walks for my dog. It wasn’t just for the wonderful benefits of exercising me and my dog, but I was earning biscuits to change up for vouchers to spend in the limited, but still useful selection of retailers. Then  in July 2026 the biscuit app users were slapped with a notice basically saying “Ok, we’re converting your current biscuits to vouchers but you’re not going to be able to use them for vouchers from this point”. The fun ride was over. Suddenly users weren’t earning anything more than 25% discounts at food and drink places and getting competition entries. Yup, you read that right, entries. No guarantees, just use your entries in the system and you MIGHT win a voucher. *Insert Roblox ooof here*. Well I think when my year of biscuit plus ends in October I will be deleting this app and never looking back. I’ve never been lucky in competitions and I seriously doubt that I will win any vouchers. So I am just going to stick to free competitions that you find on food packets, thank you very much. I’ll have just as much luck there. Oh and as for the discounts for food and drink…I don’t use those places. Thanks for the fun while it lasted.

reviews.title: Disappointed with the new look
reviews.text: I really enjoyed completing walks earning rewards. Now I completed walks to earn rewards for someone else.

reviews.title: New customer with Waggel
reviews.text: There’s lots of glitches on this app and I’m  struggling to see what biscuit plus is about . If you don’t eat / drink out / shop a lot . there’s very little benefit for customers . Plus where’s the incentive to walk etc once you have your 75 biscuits that week , which isn’t hard to get . I heard it was much better before upgraded . Often the offers are available elsewhere. So far only benifit to me is competition entries let’s hope I win . This so called format needs a re think I think .

reviews.title: Don’t download now
reviews.text: Since they changed the app, it is a waste of time and you now get discounts to coffee places I have never heard and dinner for places Sunday to Thursday! It is rubbish now don’t bother. It did provide feedback and they didn’t want to know, shame really as it is was a really app now ruined

reviews.title: Once Brilliant, Now Feels Pointless
reviews.text: Before the update, I used this app every day on my dog walks to collect biscuits. The latest update has completely ruined it by introducing an almost impossible raffle and adding a Tastecard/Coffee Club feature which is very limited and only really useful if you live in a city. I get the app free through Waggle, and I’m still tempted to delete it.

reviews.title: DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY
reviews.text:
USE to be great. Now it’s all changed to competitions/Treats etc
Don’t waste your money it absolutely is not worth it anymore.

reviews.title: Waste of time and effort. No longer worth handing over your data.
reviews.text: I’ve deleted it now as it’s not even worth the free account. No more worth while rewards. Pity as was amazing.

reviews.title: Not really a benefit anymore…
reviews.text: Since the recent change the benefits are massively reduced, 25% of places I would never go to and entries to competitions instead of an actual reward. Such a shame as the benefits are what kept me with my insurer. Hawks also say they safe and they reached the criteria but the biscuits don’t actually get allocated, really can’t be bothered to contact customer services as it’s never very helpful given they want a load of details to the walk that I can’t remember. Now when I come to renew, I will probably change!

reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text: Used to be good when first developed. Received a decent amount of biscuitsto trade in for rewards with some good options, like food shopping. Then they reduced the number of biscuits you got for walks, understandable and still worked for me. Now you don’t earn many for the time you spend walking, would take you a good few months to get a reward, and now you can’t trade them in for anything of good value. My opinion - waste of time.

reviews.title: Rubbish app since the update
reviews.text: I used to love this app , both myself and my partner were happy to pay for subscription but since the changes we’ve stopped it! You don’t offer anything that isn’t already available for free . We used to love exchanging biscuits for vouchers but now there is nothing nothing for us and from what I see many people have the same opinion.

reviews.title: The app has changed
reviews.text: I used to tell everyone about this app, you used to be able to change biscuits into vouchers. It was such a rewarding app, now you don’t get any benefits of having the app. We even had the pro account as we signed up with waggle. The treats for the coffee and dine out are basically Morrison cafe. Will now delete this app to find something else.

reviews.title: No longer rewarding
reviews.text: Started using biscuits shortly after they began, found the app useful for encouraging walks and the bonus of earning actual rewards vouchers was a huge benefit. Then came the changes, first update lowered the level of rewards you could earn without paying for the ‘PREMIUM’ tier subscription, still we carried on earning some rewards and it remained  useful. The most recent update has killed any potential reward unless you pay for ‘PREMIUM’, no reward vouchers can be earnt, merely competition entries you’ll never win. App deleted and we’ll find a company not just after your data!!!

reviews.title: Pointless App
reviews.text: Customer service awful, walks frequently fail to save. No point using it anymore as basically no reward. Don’t waste your time

reviews.title: Not worth downloading now
reviews.text: Used to be brilliant, but not worth using anymore

reviews.title: Changes
reviews.text: Really not liking the changes, can’t find Biscuits and rewards now very limited

reviews.title: Once great, now ruined
reviews.text:
I have been using Biscuit for at least 3/4 years now and was paying to be a premium member for about the last year and was happy to as it was worth it. They have now stripped out all of the benefits of the paid subscription and rendered the app useless. Just competition entries and discounts of chain coffee and other places that I have no interest in.

I have sadly cancelled my subscription as it is not worth paying for discounts on things I don’t want (also the discounts wouldn’t cover the membership costs) or tickets for competition entries. So disappointing! If they ever change it back I would happily resubscribe as it was a great app before the 1 July changes, however I doubt that will happen.

reviews.title: Not worth it since changes
reviews.text: Preferred the old rewards system and was good incentives. Now I’ve just looked and nothing motivating me to bother tracking my walk and get vouchers etc. Plus is not worth the money now either for same reasons

reviews.title: This app used to be so good and is now not worth it
reviews.text: I downloaded Biscuit a few years ago and it was so motivating and the rewards were incredible. I couldn’t justify spending the money when the paid tier was introduced as my husband often took the dogs if I was working. I’ve recently had to stop work to care for my parents and had planned on using vouchers to contribute to food or a treat for my husband and I. Since further changes have been introduced I just feel like I’m sharing data with nothing in return. So disappointed.

reviews.title: Not good now
reviews.text: I’ve had the app since 2024 and it used to be fantastic. In my first year of using it in 2024 I earned £200 in vouchers. After this, they started offering less and less points for walking. Then a ‘pay to earn’ type system, which you’re more likely to lose out on. Now there’s no vouchers at all, you can just enter a few competitions and that’s it. There’s just no point in it anymore. Totally understand they need to make money but there’s just no benefit to using the app anymore. I’m just eating up my phone data for no reason. Uninstalled.

reviews.title: Utterly pointless
reviews.text: Used to love this app when it allowed you to save biscuits for vouchers, then they changed it to a subscription for the same benefits so I cancelled it. I recently got it again, free, with my new pet insurance and I can now say the app is even worse. Pointless competition entries or discounts off restaurants/coffee places nowhere near where I live. I don’t want these kind of “rewards”. Even though I’ve not paid for, I’m cancelling anyway as it’s a complete waste of my time

reviews.title: Used to be brilliant
reviews.text: Used to really like it, used to be able to redeem a £10 voucher every couple of months. Recent changes mean that you now only get discounts through a taster card or competition entries. I already got rid of my taste card through work as I wasn’t using it so now the app is no good to me and I’ve cancelled my subscription.

reviews.title: Rewards not worth it.
reviews.text:
Used to use this app everyday and was great to track dog walks, and get a reward as a bonus. Now the rewards are 25% off restaurants that nobody wants. 
Shame as the app would have been 5* and now I don’t use it anymore

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: App doesn’t even load anymore tried logging in and creating a new account and it just doesn’t load on iPhone I can start account creation on my iPad and then gets stuck loading and doesn’t load full stop on my iPhone 17 pro max reinstalled the app 3 times and hard reset my phone twice and doesn’t work

reviews.title: Disappointing changes
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for over a year now and happily paid to have the premium account. The voucher reward system was brilliant. Unfortunately, the new system of competition entries and discounts for food and drinks (such as Morrisons cafe, brewers Fayre & Burger King) are of no use to me whatsoever. I’ve cancelled my subscription.

reviews.title: Latest change ruined it
reviews.text:
As others have said, the latest changes have completely ruined this app.
The new rewards, competitions have no relevance or interest to me. I will continue to enjoy my walks with my adorable dog without you!

reviews.title: Originally brilliant - not anymore
reviews.text: Loved this app initially. Amazing deals. Then they introduced plus - which I have - and the app is rubbish for rewards now. Only use it to map my walks and distance. But other than that - useless now!

reviews.title: Completely Pointless Now
reviews.text: Used to be great, had the subscription service and getting the Amazon vouchers really drove and challenged me to advance in the app and hit all targets to get the points and bonus points, even the kids got the app and took turns walking and hitting the targets, NOW ITS A COMPLETE WASTE OF TIME AND MONEY, no vouchers, nothing to motivate you. 25% off coffee in some random coffee shop, really, that’s like 75p off a latte ?? Absolute waste of effort now and don’t even open the app anymore, seeing as biscuit have given up, I might as well give up and just take the dog for a walk without the hassle of recording and connecting the PitPat, it’s not even worth the effort anymore.

reviews.title: Update has made it pointless
reviews.text:
Used this everyday and you used to be able to earn biscuits for walks and exchange them for cash vouchers for top retailers, Amazon, Tesco, Air BnB etc. etc. 

Since the recent update you now get competition entires instead which are completely pointless, no more money off vouchers. I’m basically using the app for a minuscule chance at a competition win, or generic offers that you can already get without the biscuit app, there’s zero incentive to use anymore. 

They’ve made what was good about the app redundant, so I will no longer be using it.

reviews.title: Maximum 2 dogs WHY???
reviews.text: There should be an option to use this app with more than 2 dogs… utterly ridiculous. Make it so the extra dogs don’t count towards rewards… but to only be able to track two dogs walks is utterly utterly ridiculous and annoying

reviews.title: Not much use to us now
reviews.text: This used to be a great app, lots of rewards that’s were useful, now there’s nothing I would use, the previous Amazon vouchers you could get were great as we used them a lot now it’s useless so not sure why I’m paying for this. Also have no idea how many biscuits I have so don’t know what I could use them against, no instructions as to how it all works either. Waste of time and money

reviews.title: Not accessible to all
reviews.text: The new rewards with the Coffee Club and Taste Card are not accessible to all. I live in a small rural town with nowhere near me included in the offers. I don’t drive and unable to use public transport due to disabilities. I signed up to plus membership to help my mental health while giving my dog more exercise. Plus membership was worth it when I could exchange biscuits for vouchers but now with the new Coffee Club and Taste Card it is not worth the monthly fee when I am never going to use those rewards. I have now had to cancel my plus membership which won’t encourage me to get more exercise or do an hours walk or longer meaning I will slip back into struggling more.

reviews.title: All good things come to an end.
reviews.text: Rubbish app now. No rewards, no benefit. I used to love getting vouchers for Costa as it helped me treat myself whilst on maternity leave. Surely they’ll take the criticism on board. Disappointed.

reviews.title: What a disappointment. Change to rewards
reviews.text:
The app used to be brilliant and it really motivated me with the various challenges to do a bit more or vary our routine a bit because we could earn money to spend in a wide variety of places. I was saving up for a particular goal and it helped get us out early before the heat or in the torrential rain. 

Frustratingly, the conversion of ‘honoured’ unused biscuits to £ after the update also gave you less £ than you would have earned before the changes. 

The new rewards (money off food and drink or competition entries) are not even remotely incentivising. They require you to spend money to get money off or enter into a competition you will most likely never win. Such a shame. I have almost completely stopped using the app during dog walks.

reviews.title: Bad changes
reviews.text: Going from guaranteed vouchers to money off for places miles away / competition entries was a terrible decision. A shame as I’ve used this app for a while, but have now stopped my subscription. It seems the team behind the app don’t seem to care about the many people leaving the app either.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for 3.5 years and seen it go from a brilliant app I would recommend to everyone, to something there is absolutely no point using now. Used to be a great way to track your dogs walks and get some vouchers out of it, then they added subscriptions and dropped the points value - luckily I was already insured through the dog insurance they deem worthy so I automatically had the premium subscription, so it was fine. Less vouchers but still getting rewards out of it. Then, at 3am on 1st July, I received an email saying “as of the 1st July we are changing the system” basically now there’s no vouchers and no incentives whatsoever. Very sneaky of them to put this into action and THEN email their customer base to let them know, meaning any points you were saving up for vouchers were now pointless. I noticed they closed the FB group as of the 29th June - they got enough pushback from bringing in the subscriptions, obviously weren’t prepared to hear from everyone once they rolled this new system out. Now there’s absolutely no reason to use the app - half the time the walks don’t track, or cut out mid way through saving, it’s incredibly not user friendly with a million buttons to click just to start or finish a walk, and you don’t even get any vouchers back! Would love to know what they thought was going to happen when they rolled this update out - clearly no one is going to carry on using the app, so well done Biscuit on completely obliterating your own business model.

reviews.title: Disappointing update now cancelling subscription
reviews.text: I was so disappointed at the recent update removing the option to earn vouchers. It’s clearly a money grab and that’s a real shame. It was a nice app and it motivated me to get out with the dog more often knowing the vouchers I could earn would help the cost of living and provide an extra treat or two for the dog. I won’t be using anymore and will no longer recommend to friends.

reviews.title: gone downhill
reviews.text: I’m honestly gutted about how bad Biscuit has become. I’d been saving up for the £50 Airbnb voucher for ages, and then they changed the rewards scheme out of nowhere. What used to be worth £40 in biscuits suddenly dropped to £14. It feels like all the time I put into it has been completely wasted. I’ll be deactivating my account because it’s just not worth it anymore.

reviews.title: Update ruined app
reviews.text: The app used to be brilliant but now version 5.1.0 means you’ve lost out on any rewards. Unless you subscribe to the plus, there is nothing for you. You can only enter competitions. Highly disappointed and do not recommend

reviews.title: Was good but not any more.
reviews.text: It was a real insensitive to track my dogs progress but sadly not any more since they changed everything. Thinking of deleting the app and looking for something else, nothing really here to keep me motivated. A shame as it was great before they messed it all up 🤦‍♀️🐾

reviews.title: I hate this app so much
reviews.text: With every “improvement” this app just becomes such a pain to use. So many clicks just to get to one single thing that you’re trying to do. I constantly have so many walks that go un tracked because there’s so many extra clicks that have now been added to either start the walk or save it. The adverts are awful and so hard to skip. UX is terrible!!!! I resent using it everyday. Probably not even worth the rewards at this point.

reviews.title: Updated July 2026
reviews.text: Update.  The recent changes make this not worth the cost any more. Plus, my screen has frozen (seems to have happened to a number of users). I paid for a year, so am very annoyed about the changes. Instead of vouchers, all I can get now is money off coffee (which I don’t drink), or discounts on restaurants I don’t eat at. Cancelling the subscription ASAP.                                           I really want to love this app, but it is frustratingly unreliable. It randomly fails to record walks for days at a time (especially when the quests involve doing walks for a number of days in a row), or just loads up a blank screen.

reviews.title: What were they thinking?
reviews.text: The latest changes will be the end of this app, what is the incentive to stay? After years of reducing down they finally got rid of vouchers altogether. But don’t worry you can pay monthly to access bad quality coffee you can get free from other apps. Who would pay for this shell of its former self? I would love to know who sat in that board room, heard this proposal and thought it was a good idea?

reviews.title: Bad changes
reviews.text: This used to be a great app and was worth the subscription. With the new changes you’re basically paying for a taster card. Not worth it, I’ve cancelled my subscription which is a shame as I’ve been using this app for around 5-6yrs.

reviews.title: App stopped refreshing
reviews.text: Have see this for about a year and gladly reaped the rewards. Now that has changed to enter competition to win a voucher. And since updating the app id frozen on the last walk I did so not even logging anything. Can’t complete the map. I’ll see what else is available .

reviews.title: Disappointing change
reviews.text: This used to be a great app and you could save up points to claim vouchers for many different retailers. There is now no way of redeeming vouchers and you instead get a small percentage off at certain restaurants or cafe’s but these are very limited in my area. There is no longer any point me using the app as there is no incentive for doing so.

reviews.title: Disappointing changes
reviews.text: Used to love this app,I used it religiously and earned vouchers which I saved for our annual holiday. Now I get a few pence off a coffee 15 miles away or a reduction on a meal,which again,nowhere near me..competition entries are all very well but with a very tiny chance of winning. So basically it’s gone from guaranteed vouchers to having to travel miles and spend money to save few pence. Not happy with the changes at all..

reviews.title: Was fantastic now dire
reviews.text: This app was brilliant and even when they started charging in 2025 it was still viable as you could spend your biscuits on rewards of your choice.  Alas 2026 sees a reduction in cost but now only benefit is perks you can get elsewhere without paying a monthly sub and some completions

reviews.title: Biscuit is sadly DEAD
reviews.text: As of July 2026 this app has been stripped back completely and now you must be a paid subscriber to access any of the benefits (best is 25% off at various places) The previous reward vouchers you could save up for have now been stopped completely. It was extremely good at the start, and then they started chipping away at it by reducing biscuits from 25 to 5 daily and increasing cost of vouchers, it was good while it lasted.

reviews.title: Cancelled subscription
reviews.text: We have used biscuit for years, and the subscription used to be worth it for the vouchers you could get. We made the subscription back easily! Now it has changed to ‘treats’ I have cancelled the subscription as it is not worth the money

reviews.title: New release on 1st July
reviews.text: Have stopped my monthly subscription and deleted the app that I’ve used for several years. Other apps tend to add functionality and user benefits of some type. Not this one, it seems to be achieving the total opposite. Oh well, still enjoying walks with our dog !

reviews.title: What was a great app has now been ruined, no longer an incentive to use it.
reviews.text:
*Changed review due to new changes  implemented 1 July.

I’d just like to pass on my feedback as someone who has been using this app for years. 

Voucher aspect of the app has been removed so now I will no longer use it, nor will I be recommending it to any more of my friends. It was the best part of the app.

Discounts off coffee and restaurants are not beneficial for your audience of dog owners and lovers. Out of touch. The vouchers were a perfect way of contributing to the wellbeing of our pets and also sometimes reducing the burden of the cost of living crisis. 

You have lost 2 users in myself and my partner, potentially more as all of my friends and family were using the app for this same reason, they now have no reason to.

UPDATE: Since Biscuit have replied, I will add my response here. I contacted the support team as soon as I learnt of the changes to express my disappointment and feedback. This has fallen on deaf ears and I was given a blanket copy and paste, patronising and irrelevant response on how to ‘get the most out of’ my new biscuit experience. Complete scam of an app. 

Got greedy and tried to cut costs to maximise profit and rip people off. AVOID.

reviews.title: Really disappointed with changes
reviews.text:
Been using Biscuit for a few years and an annual subscriber for almost a year and very disappointed with the changes. It was a great app to get points from dog walks and then using the points to get vouchers and often told people about it. Even though the subscription seemed a lot for 2 dogs it was absolutely worth it for the value of the vouchers that you could get. They have dropped the price of a monthly subscription but I won’t be continuing with the plus as it’s just not worth it anymore. I emailed the company straight away, as soon as I got the email about the changes, to check if the discounts is all we would get with Plus, as I don’t drink coffee and have had the Tastecard before and it just wasn’t worth it, and was disappointed with their reply. I’m guessing this is about making them more money but I think it has backfired as they will lose alot of subscribers. Please think about changing it back as it seems that lots of other people are not happy either.
The app has also stopped logging walks and is stuck saying your walk is saved but won’t move on.

reviews.title: Bad change!!
reviews.text: I have been using this app for a few years and enjoyed the challenges and being rewarded with vouchers for my hard work. I was miffed when they changed it and you had to either pay to upgrade to Plus or take forever in the free version to gain enough for a voucher but I did the maths and I worked out it was still pretty beneficial for me to pay the subscription as I would still be quids in so I paid for my 2 dogs. With just 2 days notice this has now changed and you can no longer earn vouchers, there is no value in me paying at all, I don’t use coffee shops and rarely eat out so don’t need the token ‘treats’ they are now offering. Also I was charged the full one month subscription (£7.99) for my 2 dogs just one week before it was changed and the subscription reduced (£3.99) so feel rather short changed… I’ve cancelled my subscription now as I feel it’s a waste of money. I may carry on using the free version as I’m in the habit of setting it before each walk but I certainly won’t be paying again, not until it is beneficial for me…. Think this has been a really bad decision made by the app, backlash I’ve read has been immense so can’t see the app surviving in its current format…

reviews.title: Ruined a good app
reviews.text:
As with others, since the massive changes introduced on 1st July the rewards are just not worth it. No prior warning other than an email 2 days before. Loved saving up for my M&S vouchers. The incentive was always there rain or shine. But now they have completely removed the daily essentials vouchers and everything else that helped with the cost of living. The only options are for the coffee club (only 1 place where I live, the rest are 25+ miles away) or the taste club for dining out (again only 1 place where I live the rest are miles away and places I wouldn’t go to). 

It was annoying when they updated the app not that long ago and made it either a free service or a paid subscription. I relented and paid but now I’ve cancelled. So disappointed that they have ruined a brilliant app that encouraged you to get out with your dog and get good rewards for it.

reviews.title: New update is terrible and has zero incentive anymore.
reviews.text: Prior to the latest update on the 1st July 2026, the app was fantastic! You rewarded your dog with walkies, whilst you were rewarded with worthy vouchers such as Sainsbury’s, Nando’s and other popular supermarkets and stores. Now it’s rewards for coffee shops and restaurants that you’ll never go to. Codes for 30% or 50% off products you’ll NEVER use. Competitions you’ll NEVER win. I used to be a Plus member but I’m cancelling and deleting the app after this. Not worth it. Shame, because my husband and I looked forward to accumulating enough Biscuit points to redeem a voucher that could help towards our food shopping. This was the ONLY app that had any reputable benefit to your household. Not anymore.

reviews.title: Not as it used to be
reviews.text:
Used to love this app as a little treat to getting up and going out. Since the new updates and changes the app is worthless unless you sign up for the premium. You used to get a lot more points for each walk to spend on rewards of your choice, then the update meant you got less so it took longer to build up and get rewards. Received an email at 2am this morning about the latest update that was coming into place today… now lost all my current points!! My points would have normally got me a good reward which i was saving for, now i can only exchange for an £8 voucher (which is nothing) or entries into a price draw? Notice should have been given about this update so I could have used my points how i normally would before hand.

Not happy with any of the updates and will no longer be recommending and deleting.

reviews.title: Used to be a great app now just another cash-grab. AVOID!!!
reviews.text:
I’ve used Biscuit for years, and it genuinely used to be an amazing community-driven pet-walking app. It felt friendly, supportive, and centred on pet wellbeing. Unfortunately, the app has completely changed — and not for the better.

Over the past year, Biscuit has become increasingly commercialised. Features that were once free and core to the community now feel locked behind paywalls, pop-ups, or upsells. The focus has shifted from helping owners bond with their pets to squeezing every possible penny out of users. What used to feel like a neighbourhood hub now feels like a storefront.

I’m far from the only one saying this. Recent App Store reviews echo the same frustrations: long-time users calling the app “greedy,” “unrecognisable,” and “a waste of time compared to what it used to be.” It’s disappointing to watch a genuinely useful tool lose its heart for the sake of profit.

Unless the developers reverse course and remember why people loved Biscuit in the first place, I’d strongly recommend avoiding it. There are other pet-walking apps out there that still value their users over monetisation.

A real shame — this was once one of my favourite apps, and now I barely recognise it.
